strings.name: Jia Zhangke
strings.summary: Drawing on small-town Shanxi, Jia records ordinary lives amid social transformation in Xiao Wu, Platform and Unknown Pleasures. His films combine documentary observation, popular music and fiction. Still Life won Venice’s Golden Lion and A Touch of Sin won Cannes screenplay honors. He co-founded Pingyao’s film festival and continues examining urbanization, migration and time in works including Caught by the Tides.
